egress.terms: Metered twice over. Free accounts have a daily downstream quota; every account, free or paid, has a monthly Basic Transfer Quota, and 'Connected Apps share 25% of this daily allowance. Up to 5 GB per day for all Connected Apps combined'. Downstream counts playback and previews, not just downloads.

tooling: Tier 1 rclone backend since v1.62, read-only for uploads? No. Backend supports read and write per rclone's table (ModTime R, hash md5). This is the crucial detail: rclone is classified as a 'Connected App', so it inherits the 5 GB/day cap.
chaining: Paid accounts offer up to 10 TB storage. Transfer limits restrict downloads to 5 GB per day via connected applications and 20 GB per day general downstream. Multiple accounts scale storage capacity while egress remains bound to individual daily quotas.
